_readme: Per-spec stat priorities transcribed from Wowhead's own stat-priority guide
page for each spec (the URL in each record). tools/wowhead_harvest.js's
__harvestStats reads the machine-parseable pages directly; the rest of the
pages state their priorities in prose or in list items Wowhead writes as
free text ('Mastery to 1200 rating', 'Haste (~700 Haste)', 'Crit = Mastery'),
so this file is the reviewed transcription of all 40 and the single source
`heroSplit` says whether Wowhead splits the priority by hero talent tree.
Where it splits by something else instead (a tank's survivability/DPS goal,
a healer's raid/Mythic+ content), the title names both hero trees so every
hero spec is still covered explicitly rather than silently omitted.
`stats` uses Data/API.lua's statPriority vocabulary; anything Wowhead ranks
that is not a character stat (item level, weapon damage) goes in `note`.

variants.title: Herald of the Sun
variants.note: Haste and Crit are ranked equal; item level beats optimising secondaries until you are near max item level

variants.title: Lightsmith
variants.note: Haste and Crit are ranked equal

variants.title: Lightsmith / Templar - Survivability
variants.note: Wowhead splits Protection Paladin by goal, not hero tree; both hero trees share these orders

variants.title: Colossus / Mountain Thane - Survivability
variants.note: Wowhead splits Protection Warrior by goal, not hero tree, and gives both goals the same order; Crit may pass Haste if your Crit is unusually low or your Haste unusually high

variants.title: Keeper of the Grove
variants.note: Haste and Crit are ranked equal

variants.title: Druid of the Claw / Elune's Chosen - Survivability
variants.note: Wowhead splits Guardian by goal, not hero tree, and gives both goals the same order; all four secondaries are close offensively

variants.title: Druid of the Claw / Elune's Chosen - DPS
San'layn
variants.note: Wowhead ranks Mastery, Crit and Versatility equal below Haste

variants.title: Deathbringer
variants.note: Wowhead ranks Mastery and Versatility equal, with Haste last

variants.title: Pack Leader
variants.note: Wowhead ranks weapon damage ahead of Agility; this order holds in every situation

variants.title: Dark Ranger
variants.note: Single-target order; in AoE swap to Mastery ahead of Crit, and the gap down to Haste widens. Weapon damage is ranked ahead of Agility

variants.title: Pack Leader
variants.note: Wowhead ranks Crit and Haste equal here, with Pack Leader wanting slightly more Haste than Sentinel

variants.title: Oracle
variants.note: Wowhead states neither hero tree changes the priority in raid or Mythic+; everything below Haste is close, so favour item level

variants.title: Voidweaver
variants.note: Wowhead's raid box lists Haste ahead of Intellect for Voidweaver; its Mythic+ box and its own text put Intellect first, which is the order used here

variants.title: Deathstalker
variants.note: Haste only to roughly 700 rating; more targets or Mythic+ push more of the budget into Mastery, pure single target wants some Crit

variants.title: Trickster
variants.note: Haste only to roughly 700 rating

variants.title: Farseer
variants.note: Wowhead ranks Mastery to about 1200 rating first and lists Intellect last; Haste and Crit are ranked equal, and Mastery is near-useless past the 100% overload cap (about 86% before embellishments)

variants.title: Stormbringer
variants.note: Wowhead ranks Mastery to about 1200 rating first and lists Intellect last; Haste and Crit are ranked equal

variants.title: Stormbringer
variants.note: Crit and Mastery are ranked equal; the priority does not change between single and multi-target

variants.title: Totemic
variants.note: Mastery and Haste are ranked equal

variants.title: Farseer
variants.note: Wowhead gives both hero trees the same order; Haste and Versatility are of similar value and Mastery is a distant last this season

variants.title: Totemic
variants.note: Haste and Versatility are of similar value; Mastery is a distant last this season

variants.title: Diabolist
variants.note: Haste and Crit are ranked equal, and all stats are close enough that item level is effectively the best stat

variants.title: Soul Harvester
variants.note: Haste and Crit are ranked equal

variants.title: Diabolist
variants.note: Mastery is ranked at or above Crit, and all stats are close enough that item level is effectively the best stat

variants.title: Hellcaller
variants.note: Mastery is ranked at or above Crit

variants.title: Shado-pan / Master of Harmony - Defensive
variants.note: Wowhead splits Brewmaster by goal and states both hero trees share these orders; item level, Agility, Armor and Stamina are ranked together first, then Versatility, Crit and Mastery equal, then Haste

variants.title: Shado-pan / Master of Harmony - Offensive
variants.note: Item level and Agility first, then Crit, then Versatility and Mastery equal, then Haste

variants.title: Conduit of the Celestials / Master of Harmony - Raid
variants.note: Wowhead splits Mistweaver by the celestial the build centres on and the content each is run in, not by hero tree; Haste is first in all content

variants.title: Conduit of the Celestials / Master of Harmony - Mythic+
variants.note: Mastery moves ahead in Mythic+ for Yu'lon-centred builds

variants.title: Aldrachi Reaver
variants.note: Item level is ranked first with Agility and Stamina; below Haste all secondaries are close to equal. Offensively Wowhead expects Crit, Versatility, Haste, Mastery

variants.title: Annihilator
variants.note: Item level is ranked first with Agility and Stamina; below Haste all secondaries are close to equal

variants.title: Flameshaper / Chronowarden - Raid
variants.note: Wowhead splits Preservation by content, not hero tree; secondaries scale off each other, so avoid hard-stacking one

variants.title: Annihilator
variants.note: Annihilator wants as much Haste as it can get

variants.title: Void-Scarred
variants.note: Haste only to roughly 800 rating (about 18-20%) and no further - past that it is the worst stat; Crit and Mastery are close, with more Mastery in Mythic+ and more Crit in raid
